# logtail_errors_microsoft_teams_integration (Resource)

This resource manages the settings of an existing Error tracking Microsoft Teams integration: which errors it posts, and to which channels. Connecting an integration needs authorization in the Better Stack UI, so this resource doesn't create one. It adopts the integration given by `integration_id`, applies the settings in your configuration and leaves every setting you don't configure as it is. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state: the integration stays connected with its current settings. You can also import an integration by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add the Better Stack app in Error tracking › Integrations › Microsoft Teams first, then adopt
# the integration by the ID from its Configure page. Settings left out stay as they are in
# Better Stack, and removing the resource leaves the integration connected.
resource "logtail_errors_microsoft_teams_integration" "errors" {
  integration_id = 123456

  # Without routes, every error goes to the channel the Better Stack app was added to.
  routes = [
    {
      applications = [
        { application_id = logtail_errors_application.this.id, environments = [] },
      ]
      channel_ids = ["19:0123456789abcdef@thread.tacv2"]
    },
  ]

  notifications {
    spikes = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (Number) The ID of the existing Microsoft Teams integration to manage, as in the URL of its Configure page in Error tracking › Integrations, or as listed by `GET /api/v1/microsoft-teams-integrations`. Changing it adopts a different integration and leaves the previous one as it is.

### Optional

- `affected_users_threshold_count` (Number) How many affected users trigger the `affected_users_threshold` notification.
- `notifications` (Block List, Max: 1) The "Notify me when" toggles. Toggles left out keep their current value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications))
- `occurrence_threshold_count` (Number) How many occurrences per `occurrence_threshold_interval` trigger the `occurrence_threshold` notification.
- `occurrence_threshold_interval` (String) The interval of `occurrence_threshold_count`: `minute`, `hour`, `day` or `week`.
- `routes` (List of Object) Which applications' errors go to which channels, each route as `{ applications = […], channel_ids = […] }`. Without routes, every error goes to the channel the Better Stack app was added to. Set to `[]` to remove every route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `tag_filter` (List of Object) Only errors whose tags match every row reach the integration, each row as `{ tag = "region", values = ["eu"] }`. Set to `[]` to remove the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the integration, the same as `integration_id`.
- `microsoft_teams_channel_name` (String) The channel the Better Stack app was added to. Without `routes`, every error goes to this channel.
- `microsoft_teams_team_name` (String) The Microsoft Teams team the Better Stack app was added to.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team the integration belongs to.
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team the integration belongs to.

<a id="nestedblock--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Optional:

- `affected_users_threshold` (Boolean) Notify when an error affects more than `affected_users_threshold_count` users.
- `automatically_reopened` (Boolean) Notify when an error is automatically re-opened.
- `new_errors` (Boolean) Notify when a new error occurs.
- `new_releases` (Boolean) Notify when a new release is observed.
- `occurrence_milestones` (Boolean) Notify when an error reaches an occurrence milestone (10, 100, 200, 500, …).
- `occurrence_threshold` (Boolean) Notify when an error occurs more than `occurrence_threshold_count` times per `occurrence_threshold_interval`.
- `spike_protection` (Boolean) Notify when spike protection starts sampling exceptions.
- `spikes` (Boolean) Notify when the application has a spike in errors.
